info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Document Versions API
Save a specific document version as the latest version of the document

items.docs: This operation creates a new document version based on the specified version and updates the document to point to this new version as the latest

info.name: Return the data for all DocumentVersions

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: fully_uploaded
params.description: Filter DocumentVersion records to those with the given `fully_uploaded` status.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier for the DocumentVersion.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of DocumentVersion records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

items.docs: Outlines the parameters, optional and required, used when requesting the data for all DocumentVersions
